detailed_description: The Mixed Chart Generator enables developers to create dual-axis visualizations combining bar and line series, ideal for comparing datasets with different measurement scales. This tool leverages HTML5 Canvas and SVG rendering to produce responsive charts that maintain clarity across devices. Technically, it processes user input through a two-stage data mapping system: categorical X-axis values are synchronized with dual Y-axes that automatically scale independently using logarithmic or linear transformations. The generator supports stacked bar configurations alongside multi-line overlays, with optional data normalization features to handle extreme value disparities. Developers will appreciate the tool's ability to handle complex data joins, where series alignment can be configured via key-value matching or positional indexing. Built-in TypeScript type guards ensure data integrity during parsing, while WebAssembly modules optimize rendering performance for large datasets. The resulting charts include interactive legends that toggle series visibility and tooltips displaying synchronized data points across both series types.
usage_steps: 1. Select 'Bar+Line' from the chart type dropdown in the configuration panel
2. Input comma-separated values in the primary data grid, specifying category labels in the first column
3. Use the 'Series Mapping' interface to assign columns to either bar clusters or line series
4. Configure dual Y-axes using the format panel: set primary axis scale type (log/linear) and secondary axis offset percentage
5. Customize visual properties through the style editor: select color palettes, adjust bar widths, and modify line tension values
6. Export the chart using the download control, choosing between SVG, PNG, or JSON configuration formats
usage_examples: Comparing monthly sales figures (bars) with profit margins (line) when financial metrics have different magnitude ranges
Visualizing temperature trends (line) against precipitation amounts (bars) in climate research reports
Displaying website traffic volume (bars) alongside conversion rates (line) for digital marketing analysis
Tracking stock prices (line) with trading volume indicators (bars) in financial dashboard development
